name: n4_commissioning_report
description: What is still wrong or unfinished below scope, in one call (read-only; about 11 station reads for the whole station whatever its size: one BQL query per table, one link scan, three slot loads and the licence page). The reply starts with summary, one line per section (ok / N finding(s) / not checked: why / skipped: why, with the truncation note), then requests (the station reads made) and each section: state (ok, findings, partial: clean in the checks that ran while others did not run, not_checked, skipped), findings (absent when no check ran) and checks. A check that ran is {count, items, more}: items are the first limit offenders as {path, name, fact} and more is how many the limit left out; a check that did not run is {not_checked: why} (a failed or impossible read: never a zero) or {skipped: why} (not asked for). Every fact is a value the station answered. points: the control points per status flag (in_fault, down, stale, disabled, overridden, in_alarm, null_output, status_unreadable); devices_down_or_disabled lists the devices that are down, disabled or in fault first, their points counted in their flags and not listed (under_listed_devices); networks_not_ok; by_network counts devices and points per driver network. histories: points_without_history (the points with no history extension below them: with expect_histories they are listed and are findings; without it the check is a count with the note pass expect_histories to list them, no list and not a finding), and the history extensions that are disabled, in_fault or never_recorded (lastRecord.timestamp null). alarms: points_without_alarm (only with expect_alarms), unknown_alarm_class (an alarm extension whose alarmClass names no class below Services/AlarmService), classes_without_recipient (no link from the class's alarm topic seen within three levels of the AlarmService), open_alarms and unacked_alarms (the classes with any, alarms is their sum). links (one scan link_depth levels below scope): unresolved_source (a source ORD that is neither a handle nor an absolute slot path, or a slot path that does not exist; source_outside_scan counts the sources not judged), inputs_with_several_links (a priority input in1..in16 targeted by more than one link), dangling_outputs (the check of n4_find_dangling_outputs; unknown counts the outputs it cannot decide). naming: duplicate_display_names among sibling points, escaped_names ($xx in the slot name), palette_default_names (a point of the control palette such as NumericWritable or BooleanPoint1, or a point called by the name of its own type plus the number the station appends, such as a kitControl:Tstat called Tstat1; a lone Tstat is not flagged). station (only when scope is the whole station): services_in_fault, licence_expiry (the warning of n4_station_health's license section), and unsaved_changes and last_backup, always not_checked with the reason: the station does not expose them to a read. Bounds: each query reads at most max_components rows; a truncated table sets truncated and truncated_note (truncated at N components: counts are lower bounds and absences are not asserted; narrow the scope), and a check that would assert an absence from it is not_checked; a link scan over max_components is not judged. spyder (only when asked in sections or with spyder_spec; one more query, two with spyder_spec): the download state of each Honeywell BACnet Spyder (select slotPath, name, enabled, deviceStatus, compileStatusFlag, sErrorStatus from honeywellBacnetSpyder:BacnetSpyder): disabled (Enabled=false, a Spyder left disabled after a download), device_status (deviceStatus other than 1), compile_status (compileStatusFlag other than 0), error_status (sErrorStatus not empty); spyders counts the Spyders read; io_mismatch (only with spyder_spec) compares each listed point's IOComp (select slotPath, SensorType, InputLow, InputHigh, OutputLow, OutputHigh, Terminal1 from honeywellSpyderTool:IOComponent) with the spec and lists the fields that differ, the points with no IOComp and the Spyders not found; a station without the Spyder modules answers the query with an error and the checks are not_checked.

scope.description: Slot path to report on, e.g. station:|slot:/Drivers/BacnetNetwork; default the whole station

sections.description: Sections to build; default all of them but spyder, which is added when spyder_spec is given

limit.description: Offenders listed per check (the count is always whole)

expect_histories.description: Which points should have a history extension: {kinds: [numeric, boolean, enum, string, writable], name_pattern: a glob such as *Temp* over the name or display name}, {} is every point; without it points_without_history is a count only

expect_alarms.description: Which points should have an alarm extension, same shape as expect_histories ({} is every point); without it points_without_alarm is skipped

spyder_spec.description: The IO each Honeywell BACnet Spyder should have, for the spyder section's io_mismatch: {<Spyder name>: {<point name>: {sensor_type, input_low, input_high, output_low, output_high, terminal}}} with names as Workbench shows them (e.g. {"2005": {"RA_T": {"sensor_type": 0, "terminal": 1}}}); numbers compare as numbers, texts ignoring case; given alone it adds the spyder section to the default sections; without it io_mismatch is skipped and only the download state is checked

link_depth.description: Component levels below scope the link scan reads (1-4); the scan loads link_depth + 3 levels of slots, so keep it low on a large scope

max_components.description: Hard cap of the rows read per query and of the components a link scan may hold

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
